label: Foreign worker flat tax rate on Korean employment income
appliesTo: Foreign employees electing the flat rate instead of the progressive brackets
why: Quoted constantly without the two conditions attached to it — that it applies to employment income only, and that electing it gives up most deductions. Recording the rate separately from those conditions keeps the number honest.

history.source: Restriction of Special Taxation Act, Article 18-2
history.note: Local income tax adds 10% of the income tax figure, so the headline combined rate is 20.9%. Applies to Korean employment income only — business, interest, dividend and rental income are taxed under the ordinary rules regardless of the election.
